display_name: DURA 源域全局复频域回归诊断
description: 对固定源 IQ 评估全局及按可观测噪声分组的广义线性频域残差回归，源记录分开拟合与验证。
authorization: User authorizes ongoing Phase1 F-free restoration research, source-only diagnostics and GPU use.

code.environment: Local RTX 5070 Ti GPU0 FP32 TF32off source IQ diagnostic

data.dataset: Phase1 Main split permitted source L_s/U_s
data.representation: 32768 source physical fit IDs x three paired received/DURA/clean IQ views; 28672 IDs fit, 4096 IDs held out
data.contract_ref: docs/PROJECT_PROTOCOL.md: 恢复器主测试口径及源数据权限
data.physical_ids_ref: Fixed source fit index modulo 8; all three views of each physical ID kept in one partition
data.validation_ref: 4096 held-out physical source fit IDs x three views; these are not target samples

permissions.claim_scope: Held-out source IQ NMSE only; no saved filter, target accuracy, deployment or real satellite claim

checkpoint.initialization: Fixed source-only DURA outputs from existing approved IQ context, no learned model checkpoint
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Source context schema, source view order, distinct 32768 source fit IDs and no F/TX/V/target
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Original DURA and source IQ context are F/TX/V/target free
checkpoint.selection_rule: Global plus four fixed source-noise quartile regressions; ridge 0.001; no target selection

execution.stop_rule: Stop on data contract mismatch, nonfinite numerical result or unavailable GPU

expected_artifacts: result.json: held-out source IQ NMSE and count, global and four observable-noise bins

metric_names: number of records with lower IQ NMSE than DURA

rows.method: Shared widely-linear spectral residual, global and fixed source-noise bins
rows.purpose: Evaluate whether population-level spectral correction can reduce held-out source IQ error without per-record clean calibration
rows.seed_notes: Deterministic split by original source index modulo 8; no new randomness
rows.scenario: 64 fixed source training IDs, three source simulation views
rows.budget_ref: 28672 source IDs x three views to fit and 4096 disjoint source IDs x three views to evaluate
expected_artifacts: result.json: held-out source IQ NMSE and count, global and four observable-noise bins

notes: Fits frequency-dependent complex residual using DURA output, received IQ and their time-domain conjugates.
Training only uses clean source IQ; noise quartile boundaries are determined from fitting records only.
Same physical ID cannot appear in fitting and held-out sets, including across source views.
This is a source feasibility diagnostic; filters are not saved or evaluated on the target, and IQ NMSE is not identity accuracy.
